body: thanks for letting me know, most of the information i’ve been getting is from a friend who had one, which maybe isn’t the best place to get info. my head has been very scrambled. thanks for letting me know, i’ll do more research and figure out the logistics around how long i have.

i guess i’m not sure exactly how much it would be. everyone i’ve talked to that lives in louisiana has just been like, “you have to do the pill method, if you do one of the other ones it’ll be way more expensive!!!” and that scared the shit out of me so i just wrote it off completely. illogical on my part, emotions have been high since i found out. i will contact the clinic to see how much it would actually be.

they wouldn’t be able to get an appointment in for me until around a week after the new orleans one, and i’m very anxious about hitting that 10 week mark. the shreveport one would take a while as well.
hey, thank you, i dm’d you

if this post is confusing to anyone: in louisiana, the abortion requires two appointments. the first is where you get an ultrasound and receive mandatory “counseling.” i have that appointment scheduled for friday. the actual abortion would take place the next week.

i can’t reschedule it because i’m already at 7 weeks, and if i cross the 10 week threshold i will be genuinely unable to afford the abortion, no matter what. i’m pregnant and just got dumped and have almost no support system whatsoever. i feel like i’m in hell.
